verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a GPU product, since vendors commonly ship command-line management and developer tooling, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents a command-line interface. The CUDA Toolkit is described only as including a compiler, libraries and debugging and optimization tools (Nsight), and calling any of these an official CLI would require outside knowledge. The NVIDIA app is described only for updating DLSS in games.
